notes: Implemented pure/mock VM foundation only: user VA/page/range math, protection/access flags, draft VmEntry backing values, split/rewrite helpers for munmap/mprotect-like value behavior, and a host-testable bounded RangeLock with writer-preference pending-writer tokens plus atomic pair acquire. No real AddressSpace, zone/cap ownership, PageContainer, frame, pmap materialization, shootdown, or user-access path was introduced. Next step is to attach these values to the zone-owned AddressSpace/recipes and page-backed materialization work after those lanes land; blocker is intentional dependency on EBR/zone and PageContainer ownership.
